'''''Asparagus aphyllus''''' is a species of plants in the family [[Asparagaceae]]. They are climbing plants. Flowers are visited by the [[Western honey bee]], ''[[Syritta pipiens]]'', ''[[Phthiria]]'', and ''[[Halictus]]''.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Asparagus aphyllus L. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/1011464|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=Asparagus aphyllus (Mediterranean Asparagus): MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/ASPG/Asparagus_aphyllus.php|access-date=2022-02-07|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref>
